s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity
salient_findings: Rigidity of axial and appendicular muscles
Vegetative state with Glasgow Coma Scale 7
key_facts: Bilateral Babinski and Chaddock signs positive
HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B and C serologies negative
ANA, anticardiolipin, ANCA, and T-spot negative
Brain CT showed a hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum
MRI revealed a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity
salient_findings: Rigidity of axial and appendicular muscles
Vegetative state with Glasgow Coma Scale 7
key_facts: Bilateral Babinski and Chaddock signs positive
HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B and C serologies negative
ANA, anticardiolipin, ANCA, and T-spot negative
Brain CT showed a hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum
MRI revealed a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body

shortlist.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
shortlist.why_kept: rapid progression of neurological symptoms and alteration of mental status

shortlist.label: Cryptococcoma
shortlist.why_kept: presence of a mass in the corpus callosum and CSF findings

shortlist.label: Gliomatosis cerebri
shortlist.why_kept: homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body and surrounding vasogenic edema

shortlist.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: rim enhancement and surrounding vasogenic edema on postcontrast T1 MRI

shortlist.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: progressive alteration of mental status and presence of a hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum

raw.rationale: The patient's rapid progression of symptoms, including apathy, unresponsiveness, and immobility, along with the presence of a vegetative state and abnormal neurological signs such as bilateral Babinski and Chaddock signs, are consistent with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease. The normal CSF fungal cultures and lack of evidence for other infectious or autoimmune causes also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cryptococcoma
rejected.why: Negative CSF fungal cultures and lack of evidence for cryptococcal infection

rejected.label: Gliomatosis cerebri
rejected.why: Imaging findings do not typically show a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum

rejected.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: Lack of evidence for lymphoma, such as abnormal cells in CSF or characteristic imaging findings

rejected.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
rejected.why: Negative JC virus testing not mentioned, but clinical presentation and imaging findings are not typical for PML
